verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents true bulk transfer-in ("up to 500 domains at a time") and setting auto-renewal across a portfolio. Its availability check spans hundreds of TLDs, and moving domains to Cloudflare repoints nameservers for multiple domains. Bulk registration, bulk manual renewal and bulk nameserver changes are not documented as batch operations; the per-domain API only gives developers building blocks for scripting them. Missing for 10: documented bulk registration, bulk renewal (beyond auto-renew toggling), bulk nameserver edits, explicit multi-domain bulk search, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user managing a portfolio, bulk operations are real — bulk search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, and transfers across many domains at once

citations.quote: You can submit up to 500 domains at a time.
Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
Move domains into the customer's own Cloudflare account — create the zone, copy the DNS across, repoint nameservers
